A launch video for the website, YouTube and LinkedIn, 1920 x 1080, modelled on the cut of a SaaS launch video: typed
lines, statements set large, the web app's desktop view in 3D, the swipe on an iPhone, three lights (white, grey
mist, black), thin lines in the background now and then. Sources in `src/launch/`: `kit.tsx` building blocks
(springs, fly-ins, typing rhythm, pointer arcs, background arcs, app frames), `parts.tsx` shared pieces (typed lines,
slamming words, key sounds), `screens.tsx` and `app-screens.tsx` the app's screens (offer card, chat, request form
with its choice sheets, Discover), `phone.tsx` the iPhone and the Feed as the app draws it on a phone,
`scenes-creator.tsx` and `scenes-brand.tsx` the scenes, `scenes.tsx` their order and lengths.

```bash
npm run launch:stills   # one still per scene (its keyframe) to out/launch/ and a contact sheet out/launch-stills.png
npm run launch:raw      # the picture only: out/launch-raw.mp4
npm run launch:audio    # regenerate its music and sounds (needs python3, numpy, ffmpeg, fluidsynth, mido)
npm run launch:render   # with sound, mastered to -14 LUFS: out/launch-final.mp4
```

The music is keynote pop, picked from four samples: 108 BPM, D flat major (I-V-vi-IV), a piano pulsing eighths, a
kalimba figure in 3-3-2, a bass in eighths, four on the floor with claps and a shaker, a glockenspiel hook in the
later grooves. The instruments are the FluidR3 GM soundfont (MIT) played through fluidsynth
(`apt install fluidsynth fluid-soundfont-gm`, `pip install mido`); kick, snaps and risers are synthesised. Quiet and
filtered under the opening lines, a break under "Ein Swipe" and under the switch to brands, drums out for the logo,
soft again under the call to action. The effects stay minimal: a quiet, muffled mechanical keyboard, a soft whip and
slam, a select tick; `SfxGain` (`src/audio.tsx`) sets their overall level. Every scene lasts whole beats (`beats` in
`src/launch/scenes.tsx`), so every cut lands on a beat; `scripts/grid.ts` hands the starts to
`scripts/make-audio.py --launch`. Change a scene's beats, then run `npm run launch:audio`. `LaunchVideo` takes `music`
and `sfx` props to render either layer on its own. The creators on Discover take a portrait each (`photo` in
`CREATORS`, `src/launch/app-screens.tsx`, a file in `public/`); without one the tile shows the initials.

npm run launch:stills   # one still per scene (its keyframe) to out/launch/ and a contact sheet out/launch-stills.png
npm run launch:raw      # the picture only: out/launch-raw.mp4
npm run launch:audio    # regenerate its music and sounds (needs python3, numpy, ffmpeg, fluidsynth, mido)
npm run launch:render   # with sound, mastered to -14 LUFS: out/launch-final.mp4
```

The music is keynote pop, picked from four samples: 108 BPM, D flat major (I-V-vi-IV), a piano pulsing eighths, a
kalimba figure in 3-3-2, a bass in eighths, four on the floor with claps and a shaker, a glockenspiel hook in the
later grooves. The instruments are the FluidR3 GM soundfont (MIT) played through fluidsynth
(`apt install fluidsynth fluid-soundfont-gm`, `pip install mido`); kick, snaps and risers are synthesised. Quiet and
filtered under the opening lines, a break under "Ein Swipe" and under the switch to brands, drums out for the logo,
soft again under the call to action. The effects stay minimal: a quiet, muffled mechanical keyboard, a soft whip and
slam, a select tick; `SfxGain` (`src/audio.tsx`) sets their overall level. Every scene lasts whole beats (`beats` in
`src/launch/scenes.tsx`), so every cut lands on a beat; `scripts/grid.ts` hands the starts to
`scripts/make-audio.py --launch`. Change a scene's beats, then run `npm run launch:audio`. `LaunchVideo` takes `music`
and `sfx` props to render either layer on its own. The creators on Discover take a portrait each (`photo` in
`CREATORS`, `src/launch/app-screens.tsx`, a file in `public/`); without one the tile shows the initials.
dA launch video for the website, YouTube and LinkedIn, 1920 x 1080, modelled on the cut of a SaaS launch video: typed
lines, statements set large, the web app's desktop view in 3D, the swipe on an iPhone, three lights (white, grey
mist, black), thin lines in the background now and then. Sources in `src/launch/`: `kit.tsx` building blocks
(springs, fly-ins, typing rhythm, pointer arcs, background arcs, app frames), `parts.tsx` shared pieces (typed lines,
slamming words, key sounds), `screens.tsx` and `app-screens.tsx` the app's screens (offer card, chat, request form
with its choice sheets, Discover), `phone.tsx` the iPhone and the Feed as the app draws it on a phone,
`scenes-creator.tsx` and `scenes-brand.tsx` the scenes, `scenes.tsx` their order and lengths.

kalimba figure in 3-3-2, a bass in eighths, four on the floor with claps and a shaker, a glockenspiel hook in the
later grooves. The instruments are the FluidR3 GM soundfont (MIT) played through fluidsynth
(`apt install fluidsynth fluid-soundfont-gm`, `pip install mido`); kick, snaps and risers are synthesised. Quiet and
filtered under the opening lines, a break under "Ein Swipe" and under the switch to brands, drums out for the logo,
soft again under the call to action. The effects stay minimal: a quiet, muffled mechanical keyboard, a soft whip and
slam, a select tick; `SfxGain` (`src/audio.tsx`) sets their overall level. Every scene lasts whole beats (`beats` in
`src/launch/scenes.tsx`), so every cut lands on a beat; `scripts/grid.ts` hands the starts to
`scripts/make-audio.py --launch`. Change a scene's beats, then run `npm run launch:audio`. `LaunchVideo` takes `music`
and `sfx` props to render either layer on its own. The creators on Discover take a portrait each (`photo` in
`CREATORS`, `src/launch/app-screens.tsx`, a file in `public/`); without one the tile shows the initials.
iA launch video for the website, YouTube and LinkedIn, 1920 x 1080, modelled on the cut of a SaaS launch video: typed
lines, statements set large, the web app's desktop view in 3D, the swipe on an iPhone, three lights (white, grey
mist, black), thin lines in the background now and then. Sources in `src/launch/`: `kit.tsx` building blocks
(springs, fly-ins, typing rhythm, pointer arcs, background arcs, app frames), `parts.tsx` shared pieces (typed lines,
slamming words, key sounds), `screens.tsx` and `app-screens.tsx` the app's screens (offer card, chat, request form
with its choice sheets, Discover), `phone.tsx` the iPhone and the Feed as the app draws it on a phone,
`scenes-creator.tsx` and `scenes-brand.tsx` the scenes, `scenes.tsx` their order and lengths.

npm run launch:raw      # the picture only: out/launch-raw.mp4
npm run launch:audio    # regenerate its music and sounds (needs python3, numpy, ffmpeg, fluidsynth, mido)
npm run launch:render   # with sound, mastered to -14 LUFS: out/launch-final.mp4
```

lines, statements set large, the web app's desktop view in 3D, the swipe on an iPhone, three lights (white, grey
mist, black), thin lines in the background now and then. Sources in `src/launch/`: `kit.tsx` building blocks

```

The music is keynote pop, picked from four samples: 108 BPM, D flat major (I-V-vi-IV), a piano pulsing eighths, a
kalimba figure in 3-3-2, a bass in eighths, four on the floor with claps and a shaker, a glockenspiel hook in the
later grooves. The instruments are the FluidR3 GM soundfont (MIT) played through fluidsynth
(`apt install fluidsynth fluid-soundfont-gm`, `pip install mido`); kick, snaps and risers are synthesised. Quiet and
filtered under the opening lines, a break under "Ein Swipe" and under the switch to brands, drums out for the logo,
soft again under the call to action. The effects stay minimal: a quiet, muffled mechanical keyboard, a soft whip and
slam, a select tick; `SfxGain` (`src/audio.tsx`) sets their overall level. Every scene lasts whole beats (`beats` in
`src/launch/scenes.tsx`), so every cut lands on a beat; `scripts/grid.ts` hands the starts to
`scripts/make-audio.py --launch`. Change a scene's beats, then run `npm run launch:audio`. `LaunchVideo` takes `music`
and `sfx` props to render either layer on its own. The creators on Discover take a portrait each (`photo` in
`CREATORS`, `src/launch/app-screens.tsx`, a file in `public/`); without one the tile shows the initials.

`scenes-creator.tsx` and `scenes-brand.tsx` the scenes, `scenes.tsx` their order and lengths.

```bash
npm run launch:stills   # one still per scene (its keyframe) to out/launch/ and a contact sheet out/launch-stills.png
npm run launch:raw      # the picture only: out/launch-raw.mp4
npm run launch:audio    # regenerate its music and sounds (needs python3, numpy, ffmpeg, fluidsynth, mido)
npm run launch:render   # with sound, mastered to -14 LUFS: out/launch-final.mp4
```

The music is keynote pop, picked from four samples: 108 BPM, D flat major (I-V-vi-IV), a piano pulsing eighths, a
kalimba figure in 3-3-2, a bass in eighths, four on the floor with claps and a shaker, a glockenspiel hook in the
later grooves. The instruments are the FluidR3 GM soundfont (MIT) played through fluidsynth
(`apt install fluidsynth fluid-soundfont-gm`, `pip install mido`); kick, snaps and risers are synthesised. Quiet and
filtered under the opening lines, a break under "Ein Swipe" and under the switch to brands, drums out for the logo,
soft again under the call to action. The effects stay minimal: a quiet, muffled mechanical keyboard, a soft whip and
slam, a select tick; `SfxGain` (`src/audio.tsx`) sets their overall level. Every scene lasts whole beats (`beats` in
`src/launch/scenes.tsx`), so every cut lands on a beat; `scripts/grid.ts` hands the starts to
`scripts/make-audio.py --launch`. Change a scene's beats, then run `npm run launch:audio`. `LaunchVideo` takes `music`
and `sfx` props to render either layer on its own. The creators on Discover take a portrait each (`photo` in
`CREATORS`, `src/launch/app-screens.tsx`, a file in `public/`); without one the tile shows the initials.

The music is keynote pop, picked from four samples: 108 BPM, D flat major (I-V-vi-IV), a piano pulsing eighths, a
kalimba figure in 3-3-2, a bass in eighths, four on the floor with claps and a shaker, a glockenspiel hook in the
later grooves. The instruments are the FluidR3 GM soundfont (MIT) played through fluidsynth
(`apt install fluidsynth fluid-soundfont-gm`, `pip install mido`); kick, snaps and risers are synthesised. Quiet and
filtered under the opening lines, a break under "Ein Swipe" and under the switch to brands, drums out for the logo,
soft again under the call to action. The effects stay minimal: a quiet, muffled mechanical keyboard, a soft whip and
slam, a select tick; `SfxGain` (`src/audio.tsx`) sets their overall level. Every scene lasts whole beats (`beats` in
`src/launch/scenes.tsx`), so every cut lands on a beat; `scripts/grid.ts` hands the starts to
`scripts/make-audio.py --launch`. Change a scene's beats, then run `npm run launch:audio`. `LaunchVideo` takes `music`
and `sfx` props to render either layer on its own. The creators on Discover take a portrait each (`photo` in
`CREATORS`, `src/launch/app-screens.tsx`, a file in `public/`); without one the tile shows the initials.

slam, a select tick; `SfxGain` (`src/audio.tsx`) sets their overall level. Every scene lasts whole beats (`beats` in
`src/launch/scenes.tsx`), so every cut lands on a beat; `scripts/grid.ts` hands the starts to
`scripts/make-audio.py --launch`. Change a scene's beats, then run `npm run launch:audio`. `LaunchVideo` takes `music`
and `sfx` props to render either layer on its own. The creators on Discover take a portrait each (`photo` in
`CREATORS`, `src/launch/app-screens.tsx`, a file in `public/`); without one the tile shows the initials.
oA launch video for the website, YouTube and LinkedIn, 1920 x 1080, modelled on the cut of a SaaS launch video: typed
lines, statements set large, the web app's desktop view in 3D, the swipe on an iPhone, three lights (white, grey
mist, black), thin lines in the background now and then. Sources in `src/launch/`: `kit.tsx` building blocks
(springs, fly-ins, typing rhythm, pointer arcs, background arcs, app frames), `parts.tsx` shared pieces (typed lines,
slamming words, key sounds), `screens.tsx` and `app-screens.tsx` the app's screens (offer card, chat, request form
with its choice sheets, Discover), `phone.tsx` the iPhone and the Feed as the app draws it on a phone,

YA launch video for the website, YouTube and LinkedIn, 1920 x 1080, modelled on the cut of a SaaS launch video: typed
lines, statements set large, the web app's desktop view in 3D, the swipe on an iPhone, three lights (white, grey

The music is keynote pop, picked from four samples: 108 BPM, D flat major (I-V-vi-IV), a piano pulsing eighths, a
kalimba figure in 3-3-2, a bass in eighths, four on the floor with claps and a shaker, a glockenspiel hook in the
later grooves. The instruments are the FluidR3 GM soundfont (MIT) played through fluidsynth
(`apt install fluidsynth fluid-soundfont-gm`, `pip install mido`); kick, snaps and risers are synthesised. Quiet and
filtered under the opening lines, a break under "Ein Swipe" and under the switch to brands, drums out for the logo,
soft again under the call to action. The effects stay minimal: a quiet, muffled mechanical keyboard, a soft whip and
slam, a select tick; `SfxGain` (`src/audio.tsx`) sets their overall level. Every scene lasts whole beats (`beats` in
`src/launch/scenes.tsx`), so every cut lands on a beat; `scripts/grid.ts` hands the starts to
`scripts/make-audio.py --launch`. Change a scene's beats, then run `npm run launch:audio`. `LaunchVideo` takes `music`
and `sfx` props to render either layer on its own. The creators on Discover take a portrait each (`photo` in
`CREATORS`, `src/launch/app-screens.tsx`, a file in `public/`); without one the tile shows the initials.

with its choice sheets, Discover), `phone.tsx` the iPhone and the Feed as the app draws it on a phone,
`scenes-creator.tsx` and `scenes-brand.tsx` the scenes, `scenes.tsx` their order and lengths.

```bash
npm run launch:stills   # one still per scene (its keyframe) to out/launch/ and a contact sheet out/launch-stills.png
npm run launch:raw      # the picture only: out/launch-raw.mp4

npm run launch:render   # with sound, mastered to -14 LUFS: out/launch-final.mp4
```

The music is keynote pop, picked from four samples: 108 BPM, D flat major (I-V-vi-IV), a piano pulsing eighths, a
kalimba figure in 3-3-2, a bass in eighths, four on the floor with claps and a shaker, a glockenspiel hook in the
later grooves. The instruments are the FluidR3 GM soundfont (MIT) played through fluidsynth
(`apt install fluidsynth fluid-soundfont-gm`, `pip install mido`); kick, snaps and risers are synthesised. Quiet and
filtered under the opening lines, a break under "Ein Swipe" and under the switch to brands, drums out for the logo,
soft again under the call to action. The effects stay minimal: a quiet, muffled mechanical keyboard, a soft whip and
slam, a select tick; `SfxGain` (`src/audio.tsx`) sets their overall level. Every scene lasts whole beats (`beats` in
`src/launch/scenes.tsx`), so every cut lands on a beat; `scripts/grid.ts` hands the starts to
`scripts/make-audio.py --launch`. Change a scene's beats, then run `npm run launch:audio`. `LaunchVideo` takes `music`
and `sfx` props to render either layer on its own. The creators on Discover take a portrait each (`photo` in
`CREATORS`, `src/launch/app-screens.tsx`, a file in `public/`); without one the tile shows the initials.

slamming words, key sounds), `screens.tsx` and `app-screens.tsx` the app's screens (offer card, chat, request form
with its choice sheets, Discover), `phone.tsx` the iPhone and the Feed as the app draws it on a phone,
`scenes-creator.tsx` and `scenes-brand.tsx` the scenes, `scenes.tsx` their order and lengths.

The music is keynote pop, picked from four samples: 108 BPM, D flat major (I-V-vi-IV), a piano pulsing eighths, a
kalimba figure in 3-3-2, a bass in eighths, four on the floor with claps and a shaker, a glockenspiel hook in the
later grooves. The instruments are the FluidR3 GM soundfont (MIT) played through fluidsynth
(`apt install fluidsynth fluid-soundfont-gm`, `pip install mido`); kick, snaps and risers are synthesised. Quiet and
filtered under the opening lines, a break under "Ein Swipe" and under the switch to brands, drums out for the logo,
soft again under the call to action. The effects stay minimal: a quiet, muffled mechanical keyboard, a soft whip and
slam, a select tick; `SfxGain` (`src/audio.tsx`) sets their overall level. Every scene lasts whole beats (`beats` in
`src/launch/scenes.tsx`), so every cut lands on a beat; `scripts/grid.ts` hands the starts to
`scripts/make-audio.py --launch`. Change a scene's beats, then run `npm run launch:audio`. `LaunchVideo` takes `music`
and `sfx` props to render either layer on its own. The creators on Discover take a portrait each (`photo` in
`CREATORS`, `src/launch/app-screens.tsx`, a file in `public/`); without one the tile shows the initials.

The music is keynote pop, picked from four samples: 108 BPM, D flat major (I-V-vi-IV), a piano pulsing eighths, a
kalimba figure in 3-3-2, a bass in eighths, four on the floor with claps and a shaker, a glockenspiel hook in the
later grooves. The instruments are the FluidR3 GM soundfont (MIT) played through fluidsynth
(`apt install fluidsynth fluid-soundfont-gm`, `pip install mido`); kick, snaps and risers are synthesised. Quiet and
filtered under the opening lines, a break under "Ein Swipe" and under the switch to brands, drums out for the logo,
soft again under the call to action. The effects stay minimal: a quiet, muffled mechanical keyboard, a soft whip and
slam, a select tick; `SfxGain` (`src/audio.tsx`) sets their overall level. Every scene lasts whole beats (`beats` in
`src/launch/scenes.tsx`), so every cut lands on a beat; `scripts/grid.ts` hands the starts to
`scripts/make-audio.py --launch`. Change a scene's beats, then run `npm run launch:audio`. `LaunchVideo` takes `music`
and `sfx` props to render either layer on its own. The creators on Discover take a portrait each (`photo` in
`CREATORS`, `src/launch/app-screens.tsx`, a file in `public/`); without one the tile shows the initials.

(springs, fly-ins, typing rhythm, pointer arcs, background arcs, app frames), `parts.tsx` shared pieces (typed lines,
slamming words, key sounds), `screens.tsx` and `app-screens.tsx` the app's screens (offer card, chat, request form
with its choice sheets, Discover), `phone.tsx` the iPhone and the Feed as the app draws it on a phone,
`scenes-creator.tsx` and `scenes-brand.tsx` the scenes, `scenes.tsx` their order and lengths.

```bash
npm run launch:stills   # one still per scene (its keyframe) to out/launch/ and a contact sheet out/launch-stills.png
npm run launch:raw      # the picture only: out/launch-raw.mp4
npm run launch:audio    # regenerate its music and sounds (needs python3, numpy, ffmpeg, fluidsynth, mido)
npm run launch:render   # with sound, mastered to -14 LUFS: out/launch-final.mp4
```

The music is keynote pop, picked from four samples: 108 BPM, D flat major (I-V-vi-IV), a piano pulsing eighths, a
kalimba figure in 3-3-2, a bass in eighths, four on the floor with claps and a shaker, a glockenspiel hook in the
later grooves. The instruments are the FluidR3 GM soundfont (MIT) played through fluidsynth
(`apt install fluidsynth fluid-soundfont-gm`, `pip install mido`); kick, snaps and risers are synthesised. Quiet and
filtered under the opening lines, a break under "Ein Swipe" and under the switch to brands, drums out for the logo,
soft again under the call to action. The effects stay minimal: a quiet, muffled mechanical keyboard, a soft whip and
slam, a select tick; `SfxGain` (`src/audio.tsx`) sets their overall level. Every scene lasts whole beats (`beats` in
`src/launch/scenes.tsx`), so every cut lands on a beat; `scripts/grid.ts` hands the starts to
`scripts/make-audio.py --launch`. Change a scene's beats, then run `npm run launch:audio`. `LaunchVideo` takes `music`
and `sfx` props to render either layer on its own. The creators on Discover take a portrait each (`photo` in
`CREATORS`, `src/launch/app-screens.tsx`, a file in `public/`); without one the tile shows the initials.

npm run launch:raw      # the picture only: out/launch-raw.mp4
npm run launch:audio    # regenerate its music and sounds (needs python3, numpy, ffmpeg, fluidsynth, mido)
npm run launch:render   # with sound, mastered to -14 LUFS: out/launch-final.mp4
```

The music is keynote pop, picked from four samples: 108 BPM, D flat major (I-V-vi-IV), a piano pulsing eighths, a
kalimba figure in 3-3-2, a bass in eighths, four on the floor with claps and a shaker, a glockenspiel hook in the
later grooves. The instruments are the FluidR3 GM soundfont (MIT) played through fluidsynth
(`apt install fluidsynth fluid-soundfont-gm`, `pip install mido`); kick, snaps and risers are synthesised. Quiet and
filtered under the opening lines, a break under "Ein Swipe" and under the switch to brands, drums out for the logo,
soft again under the call to action. The effects stay minimal: a quiet, muffled mechanical keyboard, a soft whip and
slam, a select tick; `SfxGain` (`src/audio.tsx`) sets their overall level. Every scene lasts whole beats (`beats` in
`src/launch/scenes.tsx`), so every cut lands on a beat; `scripts/grid.ts` hands the starts to
`scripts/make-audio.py --launch`. Change a scene's beats, then run `npm run launch:audio`. `LaunchVideo` takes `music`
and `sfx` props to render either layer on its own. The creators on Discover take a portrait each (`photo` in
`CREATORS`, `src/launch/app-screens.tsx`, a file in `public/`); without one the tile shows the initials.
pA launch video for the website, YouTube and LinkedIn, 1920 x 1080, modelled on the cut of a SaaS launch video: typed
lines, statements set large, the web app's desktop view in 3D, the swipe on an iPhone, three lights (white, grey
mist, black), thin lines in the background now and then. Sources in `src/launch/`: `kit.tsx` building blocks
(springs, fly-ins, typing rhythm, pointer arcs, background arcs, app frames), `parts.tsx` shared pieces (typed lines,
slamming words, key sounds), `screens.tsx` and `app-screens.tsx` the app's screens (offer card, chat, request form
with its choice sheets, Discover), `phone.tsx` the iPhone and the Feed as the app draws it on a phone,
`scenes-creator.tsx` and `scenes-brand.tsx` the scenes, `scenes.tsx` their order and lengths.

`scripts/make-audio.py --launch`. Change a scene's beats, then run `npm run launch:audio`. `LaunchVideo` takes `music`
and `sfx` props to render either layer on its own. The creators on Discover take a portrait each (`photo` in
`CREATORS`, `src/launch/app-screens.tsx`, a file in `public/`); without one the tile shows the initials.

A launch video for the website, YouTube and LinkedIn, 1920 x 1080, modelled on the cut of a SaaS launch video: typed
lines, statements set large, the web app's desktop view in 3D, the swipe on an iPhone, three lights (white, grey
mist, black), thin lines in the background now and then. Sources in `src/launch/`: `kit.tsx` building blocks
(springs, fly-ins, typing rhythm, pointer arcs, background arcs, app frames), `parts.tsx` shared pieces (typed lines,
slamming words, key sounds), `screens.tsx` and `app-screens.tsx` the app's screens (offer card, chat, request form
with its choice sheets, Discover), `phone.tsx` the iPhone and the Feed as the app draws it on a phone,
`scenes-creator.tsx` and `scenes-brand.tsx` the scenes, `scenes.tsx` their order and lengths.

```bash
npm run launch:stills   # one still per scene (its keyframe) to out/launch/ and a contact sheet out/launch-stills.png
npm run launch:raw      # the picture only: out/launch-raw.mp4
npm run launch:audio    # regenerate its music and sounds (needs python3, numpy, ffmpeg, fluidsynth, mido)
npm run launch:render   # with sound, mastered to -14 LUFS: out/launch-final.mp4
```

The music is keynote pop, picked from four samples: 108 BPM, D flat major (I-V-vi-IV), a piano pulsing eighths, a
kalimba figure in 3-3-2, a bass in eighths, four on the floor with claps and a shaker, a glockenspiel hook in the
later grooves. The instruments are the FluidR3 GM soundfont (MIT) played through fluidsynth
(`apt install fluidsynth fluid-soundfont-gm`, `pip install mido`); kick, snaps and risers are synthesised. Quiet and
filtered under the opening lines, a break under "Ein Swipe" and under the switch to brands, drums out for the logo,
soft again under the call to action. The effects stay minimal: a quiet, muffled mechanical keyboard, a soft whip and

and `sfx` props to render either layer on its own. The creators on Discover take a portrait each (`photo` in

mist, black), thin lines in the background now and then. Sources in `src/launch/`: `kit.tsx` building blocks
(springs, fly-ins, typing rhythm, pointer arcs, background arcs, app frames), `parts.tsx` shared pieces (typed lines,
slamming words, key sounds), `screens.tsx` and `app-screens.tsx` the app's screens (offer card, chat, request form
with its choice sheets, Discover), `phone.tsx` the iPhone and the Feed as the app draws it on a phone,
`scenes-creator.tsx` and `scenes-brand.tsx` the scenes, `scenes.tsx` their order and lengths.

```bash
npm run launch:stills   # one still per scene (its keyframe) to out/launch/ and a contact sheet out/launch-stills.png
npm run launch:raw      # the picture only: out/launch-raw.mp4
npm run launch:audio    # regenerate its music and sounds (needs python3, numpy, ffmpeg, fluidsynth, mido)
npm run launch:render   # with sound, mastered to -14 LUFS: out/launch-final.mp4
```

The music is keynote pop, picked from four samples: 108 BPM, D flat major (I-V-vi-IV), a piano pulsing eighths, a
kalimba figure in 3-3-2, a bass in eighths, four on the floor with claps and a shaker, a glockenspiel hook in the
later grooves. The instruments are the FluidR3 GM soundfont (MIT) played through fluidsynth
(`apt install fluidsynth fluid-soundfont-gm`, `pip install mido`); kick, snaps and risers are synthesised. Quiet and
filtered under the opening lines, a break under "Ein Swipe" and under the switch to brands, drums out for the logo,
soft again under the call to action. The effects stay minimal: a quiet, muffled mechanical keyboard, a soft whip and
slam, a select tick; `SfxGain` (`src/audio.tsx`) sets their overall level. Every scene lasts whole beats (`beats` in
`src/launch/scenes.tsx`), so every cut lands on a beat; `scripts/grid.ts` hands the starts to
`scripts/make-audio.py --launch`. Change a scene's beats, then run `npm run launch:audio`. `LaunchVideo` takes `music`
and `sfx` props to render either layer on its own. The creators on Discover take a portrait each (`photo` in
`CREATORS`, `src/launch/app-screens.tsx`, a file in `public/`); without one the tile shows the initials.

npm run launch:stills   # one still per scene (its keyframe) to out/launch/ and a contact sheet out/launch-stills.png
npm run launch:raw      # the picture only: out/launch-raw.mp4
npm run launch:audio    # regenerate its music and sounds (needs python3, numpy, ffmpeg, fluidsynth, mido)
npm run launch:render   # with sound, mastered to -14 LUFS: out/launch-final.mp4
```

The music is keynote pop, picked from four samples: 108 BPM, D flat major (I-V-vi-IV), a piano pulsing eighths, a
kalimba figure in 3-3-2, a bass in eighths, four on the floor with claps and a shaker, a glockenspiel hook in the
later grooves. The instruments are the FluidR3 GM soundfont (MIT) played through fluidsynth
(`apt install fluidsynth fluid-soundfont-gm`, `pip install mido`); kick, snaps and risers are synthesised. Quiet and
filtered under the opening lines, a break under "Ein Swipe" and under the switch to brands, drums out for the logo,
soft again under the call to action. The effects stay minimal: a quiet, muffled mechanical keyboard, a soft whip and
slam, a select tick; `SfxGain` (`src/audio.tsx`) sets their overall level. Every scene lasts whole beats (`beats` in
`src/launch/scenes.tsx`), so every cut lands on a beat; `scripts/grid.ts` hands the starts to
`scripts/make-audio.py --launch`. Change a scene's beats, then run `npm run launch:audio`. `LaunchVideo` takes `music`
and `sfx` props to render either layer on its own. The creators on Discover take a portrait each (`photo` in
`CREATORS`, `src/launch/app-screens.tsx`, a file in `public/`); without one the tile shows the initials.
 A launch video for the website, YouTube and LinkedIn, 1920 x 1080, modelled on the cut of a SaaS launch video: typed
lines, statements set large, the web app's desktop view in 3D, the swipe on an iPhone, three lights (white, grey
mist, black), thin lines in the background now and then. Sources in `src/launch/`: `kit.tsx` building blocks
(springs, fly-ins, typing rhythm, pointer arcs, background arcs, app frames), `parts.tsx` shared pieces (typed lines,
slamming words, key sounds), `screens.tsx` and `app-screens.tsx` the app's screens (offer card, chat, request form
with its choice sheets, Discover), `phone.tsx` the iPhone and the Feed as the app draws it on a phone,
`scenes-creator.tsx` and `scenes-brand.tsx` the scenes, `scenes.tsx` their order and lengths.

later grooves. The instruments are the FluidR3 GM soundfont (MIT) played through fluidsynth
(`apt install fluidsynth fluid-soundfont-gm`, `pip install mido`); kick, snaps and risers are synthesised. Quiet and
filtered under the opening lines, a break under "Ein Swipe" and under the switch to brands, drums out for the logo,
soft again under the call to action. The effects stay minimal: a quiet, muffled mechanical keyboard, a soft whip and
slam, a select tick; `SfxGain` (`src/audio.tsx`) sets their overall level. Every scene lasts whole beats (`beats` in
`src/launch/scenes.tsx`), so every cut lands on a beat; `scripts/grid.ts` hands the starts to
`scripts/make-audio.py --launch`. Change a scene's beats, then run `npm run launch:audio`. `LaunchVideo` takes `music`
and `sfx` props to render either layer on its own. The creators on Discover take a portrait each (`photo` in
`CREATORS`, `src/launch/app-screens.tsx`, a file in `public/`); without one the tile shows the initials.
aA launch video for the website, YouTube and LinkedIn, 1920 x 1080, modelled on the cut of a SaaS launch video: typed
lines, statements set large, the web app's desktop view in 3D, the swipe on an iPhone, three lights (white, grey
mist, black), thin lines in the background now and then. Sources in `src/launch/`: `kit.tsx` building blocks
(springs, fly-ins, typing rhythm, pointer arcs, background arcs, app frames), `parts.tsx` shared pieces (typed lines,
slamming words, key sounds), `screens.tsx` and `app-screens.tsx` the app's screens (offer card, chat, request form
with its choice sheets, Discover), `phone.tsx` the iPhone and the Feed as the app draws it on a phone,
`scenes-creator.tsx` and `scenes-brand.tsx` the scenes, `scenes.tsx` their order and lengths.

```bash
npm run launch:stills   # one still per scene (its keyframe) to out/launch/ and a contact sheet out/launch-stills.png
npm run launch:raw      # the picture only: out/launch-raw.mp4
npm run launch:audio    # regenerate its music and sounds (needs python3, numpy, ffmpeg, fluidsynth, mido)
npm run launch:render   # with sound, mastered to -14 LUFS: out/launch-final.mp4
```

The music is keynote pop, picked from four samples: 108 BPM, D flat major (I-V-vi-IV), a piano pulsing eighths, a
kalimba figure in 3-3-2, a bass in eighths, four on the floor with claps and a shaker, a glockenspiel hook in the
later grooves. The instruments are the FluidR3 GM soundfont (MIT) played through fluidsynth
(`apt install fluidsynth fluid-soundfont-gm`, `pip install mido`); kick, snaps and risers are synthesised. Quiet and
filtered under the opening lines, a break under "Ein Swipe" and under the switch to brands, drums out for the logo,
soft again under the call to action. The effects stay minimal: a quiet, muffled mechanical keyboard, a soft whip and
slam, a select tick; `SfxGain` (`src/audio.tsx`) sets their overall level. Every scene lasts whole beats (`beats` in
`src/launch/scenes.tsx`), so every cut lands on a beat; `scripts/grid.ts` hands the starts to
`scripts/make-audio.py --launch`. Change a scene's beats, then run `npm run launch:audio`. `LaunchVideo` takes `music`
and `sfx` props to render either layer on its own. The creators on Discover take a portrait each (`photo` in
`CREATORS`, `src/launch/app-screens.tsx`, a file in `public/`); without one the tile shows the initials.

`scenes-creator.tsx` and `scenes-brand.tsx` the scenes, `scenes.tsx` their order and lengths.

```bash
npm run launch:stills   # one still per scene (its keyframe) to out/launch/ and a contact sheet out/launch-stills.png
npm run launch:raw      # the picture only: out/launch-raw.mp4
npm run launch:audio    # regenerate its music and sounds (needs python3, numpy, ffmpeg, fluidsynth, mido)
npm run launch:render   # with sound, mastered to -14 LUFS: out/launch-final.mp4
```

The music is keynote pop, picked from four samples: 108 BPM, D flat major (I-V-vi-IV), a piano pulsing eighths, a
kalimba figure in 3-3-2, a bass in eighths, four on the floor with claps and a shaker, a glockenspiel hook in the
later grooves. The instruments are the FluidR3 GM soundfont (MIT) played through fluidsynth
(`apt install fluidsynth fluid-soundfont-gm`, `pip install mido`); kick, snaps and risers are synthesised. Quiet and
filtered under the opening lines, a break under "Ein Swipe" and under the switch to brands, drums out for the logo,
soft again under the call to action. The effects stay minimal: a quiet, muffled mechanical keyboard, a soft whip and
slam, a select tick; `SfxGain` (`src/audio.tsx`) sets their overall level. Every scene lasts whole beats (`beats` in
`src/launch/scenes.tsx`), so every cut lands on a beat; `scripts/grid.ts` hands the starts to
`scripts/make-audio.py --launch`. Change a scene's beats, then run `npm run launch:audio`. `LaunchVideo` takes `music`
and `sfx` props to render either layer on its own. The creators on Discover take a portrait each (`photo` in
`CREATORS`, `src/launch/app-screens.tsx`, a file in `public/`); without one the tile shows the initials.

The music is keynote pop, picked from four samples: 108 BPM, D flat major (I-V-vi-IV), a piano pulsing eighths, a
kalimba figure in 3-3-2, a bass in eighths, four on the floor with claps and a shaker, a glockenspiel hook in the
later grooves. The instruments are the FluidR3 GM soundfont (MIT) played through fluidsynth
(`apt install fluidsynth fluid-soundfont-gm`, `pip install mido`); kick, snaps and risers are synthesised. Quiet and
filtered under the opening lines, a break under "Ein Swipe" and under the switch to brands, drums out for the logo,
soft again under the call to action. The effects stay minimal: a quiet, muffled mechanical keyboard, a soft whip and
slam, a select tick; `SfxGain` (`src/audio.tsx`) sets their overall level. Every scene lasts whole beats (`beats` in
`src/launch/scenes.tsx`), so every cut lands on a beat; `scripts/grid.ts` hands the starts to
`scripts/make-audio.py --launch`. Change a scene's beats, then run `npm run launch:audio`. `LaunchVideo` takes `music`
and `sfx` props to render either layer on its own. The creators on Discover take a portrait each (`photo` in
`CREATORS`, `src/launch/app-screens.tsx`, a file in `public/`); without one the tile shows the initials.

slam, a select tick; `SfxGain` (`src/audio.tsx`) sets their overall level. Every scene lasts whole beats (`beats` in
`src/launch/scenes.tsx`), so every cut lands on a beat; `scripts/grid.ts` hands the starts to
`scripts/make-audio.py --launch`. Change a scene's beats, then run `npm run launch:audio`. `LaunchVideo` takes `music`
and `sfx` props to render either layer on its own. The creators on Discover take a portrait each (`photo` in
`CREATORS`, `src/launch/app-screens.tsx`, a file in `public/`); without one the tile shows the initials.

lines, statements set large, the web app's desktop view in 3D, the swipe on an iPhone, three lights (white, grey
mist, black), thin lines in the background now and then. Sources in `src/launch/`: `kit.tsx` building blocks
(springs, fly-ins, typing rhythm, pointer arcs, background arcs, app frames), `parts.tsx` shared pieces (typed lines,
slamming words, key sounds), `screens.tsx` and `app-screens.tsx` the app's screens (offer card, chat, request form

dA launch video for the website, YouTube and LinkedIn, 1920 x 1080, modelled on the cut of a SaaS launch video: typed

The music is keynote pop, picked from four samples: 108 BPM, D flat major (I-V-vi-IV), a piano pulsing eighths, a
kalimba figure in 3-3-2, a bass in eighths, four on the floor with claps and a shaker, a glockenspiel hook in the
later grooves. The instruments are the FluidR3 GM soundfont (MIT) played through fluidsynth
(`apt install fluidsynth fluid-soundfont-gm`, `pip install mido`); kick, snaps and risers are synthesised. Quiet and
filtered under the opening lines, a break under "Ein Swipe" and under the switch to brands, drums out for the logo,
soft again under the call to action. The effects stay minimal: a quiet, muffled mechanical keyboard, a soft whip and
slam, a select tick; `SfxGain` (`src/audio.tsx`) sets their overall level. Every scene lasts whole beats (`beats` in
`src/launch/scenes.tsx`), so every cut lands on a beat; `scripts/grid.ts` hands the starts to
`scripts/make-audio.py --launch`. Change a scene's beats, then run `npm run launch:audio`. `LaunchVideo` takes `music`
and `sfx` props to render either layer on its own. The creators on Discover take a portrait each (`photo` in
`CREATORS`, `src/launch/app-screens.tsx`, a file in `public/`); without one the tile shows the initials.

with its choice sheets, Discover), `phone.tsx` the iPhone and the Feed as the app draws it on a phone,

```bash

```

The music is keynote pop, picked from four samples: 108 BPM, D flat major (I-V-vi-IV), a piano pulsing eighths, a
kalimba figure in 3-3-2, a bass in eighths, four on the floor with claps and a shaker, a glockenspiel hook in the
later grooves. The instruments are the FluidR3 GM soundfont (MIT) played through fluidsynth
(`apt install fluidsynth fluid-soundfont-gm`, `pip install mido`); kick, snaps and risers are synthesised. Quiet and
filtered under the opening lines, a break under "Ein Swipe" and under the switch to brands, drums out for the logo,
soft again under the call to action. The effects stay minimal: a quiet, muffled mechanical keyboard, a soft whip and
slam, a select tick; `SfxGain` (`src/audio.tsx`) sets their overall level. Every scene lasts whole beats (`beats` in
`src/launch/scenes.tsx`), so every cut lands on a beat; `scripts/grid.ts` hands the starts to
`scripts/make-audio.py --launch`. Change a scene's beats, then run `npm run launch:audio`. `LaunchVideo` takes `music`
and `sfx` props to render either layer on its own. The creators on Discover take a portrait each (`photo` in
`CREATORS`, `src/launch/app-screens.tsx`, a file in `public/`); without one the tile shows the initials.

The music is keynote pop, picked from four samples: 108 BPM, D flat major (I-V-vi-IV), a piano pulsing eighths, a
kalimba figure in 3-3-2, a bass in eighths, four on the floor with claps and a shaker, a glockenspiel hook in the
later grooves. The instruments are the FluidR3 GM soundfont (MIT) played through fluidsynth
(`apt install fluidsynth fluid-soundfont-gm`, `pip install mido`); kick, snaps and risers are synthesised. Quiet and
filtered under the opening lines, a break under "Ein Swipe" and under the switch to brands, drums out for the logo,
soft again under the call to action. The effects stay minimal: a quiet, muffled mechanical keyboard, a soft whip and
slam, a select tick; `SfxGain` (`src/audio.tsx`) sets their overall level. Every scene lasts whole beats (`beats` in
`src/launch/scenes.tsx`), so every cut lands on a beat; `scripts/grid.ts` hands the starts to
`scripts/make-audio.py --launch`. Change a scene's beats, then run `npm run launch:audio`. `LaunchVideo` takes `music`
and `sfx` props to render either layer on its own. The creators on Discover take a portrait each (`photo` in
`CREATORS`, `src/launch/app-screens.tsx`, a file in `public/`); without one the tile shows the initials.

filtered under the opening lines, a break under "Ein Swipe" and under the switch to brands, drums out for the logo,

The music is keynote pop, picked from four samples: 108 BPM, D flat major (I-V-vi-IV), a piano pulsing eighths, a
kalimba figure in 3-3-2, a bass in eighths, four on the floor with claps and a shaker, a glockenspiel hook in the
later grooves. The instruments are the FluidR3 GM soundfont (MIT) played through fluidsynth
(`apt install fluidsynth fluid-soundfont-gm`, `pip install mido`); kick, snaps and risers are synthesised. Quiet and
filtered under the opening lines, a break under "Ein Swipe" and under the switch to brands, drums out for the logo,
soft again under the call to action. The effects stay minimal: a quiet, muffled mechanical keyboard, a soft whip and
slam, a select tick; `SfxGain` (`src/audio.tsx`) sets their overall level. Every scene lasts whole beats (`beats` in
`src/launch/scenes.tsx`), so every cut lands on a beat; `scripts/grid.ts` hands the starts to

and `sfx` props to render either layer on its own. The creators on Discover take a portrait each (`photo` in
`CREATORS`, `src/launch/app-screens.tsx`, a file in `public/`); without one the tile shows the initials.

(springs, fly-ins, typing rhythm, pointer arcs, background arcs, app frames), `parts.tsx` shared pieces (typed lines,
slamming words, key sounds), `screens.tsx` and `app-screens.tsx` the app's screens (offer card, chat, request form
with its choice sheets, Discover), `phone.tsx` the iPhone and the Feed as the app draws it on a phone,
`scenes-creator.tsx` and `scenes-brand.tsx` the scenes, `scenes.tsx` their order and lengths.

```bash
npm run launch:stills   # one still per scene (its keyframe) to out/launch/ and a contact sheet out/launch-stills.png
npm run launch:raw      # the picture only: out/launch-raw.mp4
npm run launch:audio    # regenerate its music and sounds (needs python3, numpy, ffmpeg, fluidsynth, mido)
npm run launch:render   # with sound, mastered to -14 LUFS: out/launch-final.mp4
```

The music is keynote pop, picked from four samples: 108 BPM, D flat major (I-V-vi-IV), a piano pulsing eighths, a
kalimba figure in 3-3-2, a bass in eighths, four on the floor with claps and a shaker, a glockenspiel hook in the
later grooves. The instruments are the FluidR3 GM soundfont (MIT) played through fluidsynth
(`apt install fluidsynth fluid-soundfont-gm`, `pip install mido`); kick, snaps and risers are synthesised. Quiet and
filtered under the opening lines, a break under "Ein Swipe" and under the switch to brands, drums out for the logo,
soft again under the call to action. The effects stay minimal: a quiet, muffled mechanical keyboard, a soft whip and
slam, a select tick; `SfxGain` (`src/audio.tsx`) sets their overall level. Every scene lasts whole beats (`beats` in
`src/launch/scenes.tsx`), so every cut lands on a beat; `scripts/grid.ts` hands the starts to
`scripts/make-audio.py --launch`. Change a scene's beats, then run `npm run launch:audio`. `LaunchVideo` takes `music`
and `sfx` props to render either layer on its own. The creators on Discover take a portrait each (`photo` in
`CREATORS`, `src/launch/app-screens.tsx`, a file in `public/`); without one the tile shows the initials.

npm run launch:stills   # one still per scene (its keyframe) to out/launch/ and a contact sheet out/launch-stills.png
npm run launch:raw      # the picture only: out/launch-raw.mp4
npm run launch:audio    # regenerate its music and sounds (needs python3, numpy, ffmpeg, fluidsynth, mido)
npm run launch:render   # with sound, mastered to -14 LUFS: out/launch-final.mp4
```

The music is keynote pop, picked from four samples: 108 BPM, D flat major (I-V-vi-IV), a piano pulsing eighths, a
kalimba figure in 3-3-2, a bass in eighths, four on the floor with claps and a shaker, a glockenspiel hook in the
later grooves. The instruments are the FluidR3 GM soundfont (MIT) played through fluidsynth
(`apt install fluidsynth fluid-soundfont-gm`, `pip install mido`); kick, snaps and risers are synthesised. Quiet and
filtered under the opening lines, a break under "Ein Swipe" and under the switch to brands, drums out for the logo,
soft again under the call to action. The effects stay minimal: a quiet, muffled mechanical keyboard, a soft whip and
slam, a select tick; `SfxGain` (`src/audio.tsx`) sets their overall level. Every scene lasts whole beats (`beats` in
`src/launch/scenes.tsx`), so every cut lands on a beat; `scripts/grid.ts` hands the starts to
`scripts/make-audio.py --launch`. Change a scene's beats, then run `npm run launch:audio`. `LaunchVideo` takes `music`
and `sfx` props to render either layer on its own. The creators on Discover take a portrait each (`photo` in
`CREATORS`, `src/launch/app-screens.tsx`, a file in `public/`); without one the tile shows the initials.
sA launch video for the website, YouTube and LinkedIn, 1920 x 1080, modelled on the cut of a SaaS launch video: typed
lines, statements set large, the web app's desktop view in 3D, the swipe on an iPhone, three lights (white, grey
mist, black), thin lines in the background now and then. Sources in `src/launch/`: `kit.tsx` building blocks
(springs, fly-ins, typing rhythm, pointer arcs, background arcs, app frames), `parts.tsx` shared pieces (typed lines,
slamming words, key sounds), `screens.tsx` and `app-screens.tsx` the app's screens (offer card, chat, request form
with its choice sheets, Discover), `phone.tsx` the iPhone and the Feed as the app draws it on a phone,
`scenes-creator.tsx` and `scenes-brand.tsx` the scenes, `scenes.tsx` their order and lengths.

later grooves. The instruments are the FluidR3 GM soundfont (MIT) played through fluidsynth
(`apt install fluidsynth fluid-soundfont-gm`, `pip install mido`); kick, snaps and risers are synthesised. Quiet and
filtered under the opening lines, a break under "Ein Swipe" and under the switch to brands, drums out for the logo,
soft again under the call to action. The effects stay minimal: a quiet, muffled mechanical keyboard, a soft whip and
slam, a select tick; `SfxGain` (`src/audio.tsx`) sets their overall level. Every scene lasts whole beats (`beats` in
`src/launch/scenes.tsx`), so every cut lands on a beat; `scripts/grid.ts` hands the starts to
`scripts/make-audio.py --launch`. Change a scene's beats, then run `npm run launch:audio`. `LaunchVideo` takes `music`
and `sfx` props to render either layer on its own. The creators on Discover take a portrait each (`photo` in
`CREATORS`, `src/launch/app-screens.tsx`, a file in `public/`); without one the tile shows the initials.
 A launch video for the website, YouTube and LinkedIn, 1920 x 1080, modelled on the cut of a SaaS launch video: typed
lines, statements set large, the web app's desktop view in 3D, the swipe on an iPhone, three lights (white, grey
mist, black), thin lines in the background now and then. Sources in `src/launch/`: `kit.tsx` building blocks
(springs, fly-ins, typing rhythm, pointer arcs, background arcs, app frames), `parts.tsx` shared pieces (typed lines,
slamming words, key sounds), `screens.tsx` and `app-screens.tsx` the app's screens (offer card, chat, request form
with its choice sheets, Discover), `phone.tsx` the iPhone and the Feed as the app draws it on a phone,
`scenes-creator.tsx` and `scenes-brand.tsx` the scenes, `scenes.tsx` their order and lengths.

```bash
npm run launch:stills   # one still per scene (its keyframe) to out/launch/ and a contact sheet out/launch-stills.png
npm run launch:raw      # the picture only: out/launch-raw.mp4
npm run launch:audio    # regenerate its music and sounds (needs python3, numpy, ffmpeg, fluidsynth, mido)
npm run launch:render   # with sound, mastered to -14 LUFS: out/launch-final.mp4
```

lines, statements set large, the web app's desktop view in 3D, the swipe on an iPhone, three lights (white, grey
mist, black), thin lines in the background now and then. Sources in `src/launch/`: `kit.tsx` building blocks

The music is keynote pop, picked from four samples: 108 BPM, D flat major (I-V-vi-IV), a piano pulsing eighths, a
kalimba figure in 3-3-2, a bass in eighths, four on the floor with claps and a shaker, a glockenspiel hook in the
later grooves. The instruments are the FluidR3 GM soundfont (MIT) played through fluidsynth
(`apt install fluidsynth fluid-soundfont-gm`, `pip install mido`); kick, snaps and risers are synthesised. Quiet and
filtered under the opening lines, a break under "Ein Swipe" and under the switch to brands, drums out for the logo,
soft again under the call to action. The effects stay minimal: a quiet, muffled mechanical keyboard, a soft whip and
slam, a select tick; `SfxGain` (`src/audio.tsx`) sets their overall level. Every scene lasts whole beats (`beats` in
`src/launch/scenes.tsx`), so every cut lands on a beat; `scripts/grid.ts` hands the starts to
`scripts/make-audio.py --launch`. Change a scene's beats, then run `npm run launch:audio`. `LaunchVideo` takes `music`
and `sfx` props to render either layer on its own. The creators on Discover take a portrait each (`photo` in
`CREATORS`, `src/launch/app-screens.tsx`, a file in `public/`); without one the tile shows the initials.

```bash
npm run launch:stills   # one still per scene (its keyframe) to out/launch/ and a contact sheet out/launch-stills.png
npm run launch:raw      # the picture only: out/launch-raw.mp4
npm run launch:audio    # regenerate its music and sounds (needs python3, numpy, ffmpeg, fluidsynth, mido)
npm run launch:render   # with sound, mastered to -14 LUFS: out/launch-final.mp4
```

The music is keynote pop, picked from four samples: 108 BPM, D flat major (I-V-vi-IV), a piano pulsing eighths, a
kalimba figure in 3-3-2, a bass in eighths, four on the floor with claps and a shaker, a glockenspiel hook in the
later grooves. The instruments are the FluidR3 GM soundfont (MIT) played through fluidsynth
(`apt install fluidsynth fluid-soundfont-gm`, `pip install mido`); kick, snaps and risers are synthesised. Quiet and
filtered under the opening lines, a break under "Ein Swipe" and under the switch to brands, drums out for the logo,
soft again under the call to action. The effects stay minimal: a quiet, muffled mechanical keyboard, a soft whip and
slam, a select tick; `SfxGain` (`src/audio.tsx`) sets their overall level. Every scene lasts whole beats (`beats` in
`src/launch/scenes.tsx`), so every cut lands on a beat; `scripts/grid.ts` hands the starts to
`scripts/make-audio.py --launch`. Change a scene's beats, then run `npm run launch:audio`. `LaunchVideo` takes `music`
and `sfx` props to render either layer on its own. The creators on Discover take a portrait each (`photo` in
`CREATORS`, `src/launch/app-screens.tsx`, a file in `public/`); without one the tile shows the initials.

The music is keynote pop, picked from four samples: 108 BPM, D flat major (I-V-vi-IV), a piano pulsing eighths, a
kalimba figure in 3-3-2, a bass in eighths, four on the floor with claps and a shaker, a glockenspiel hook in the
later grooves. The instruments are the FluidR3 GM soundfont (MIT) played through fluidsynth
(`apt install fluidsynth fluid-soundfont-gm`, `pip install mido`); kick, snaps and risers are synthesised. Quiet and
filtered under the opening lines, a break under "Ein Swipe" and under the switch to brands, drums out for the logo,
soft again under the call to action. The effects stay minimal: a quiet, muffled mechanical keyboard, a soft whip and
slam, a select tick; `SfxGain` (`src/audio.tsx`) sets their overall level. Every scene lasts whole beats (`beats` in
`src/launch/scenes.tsx`), so every cut lands on a beat; `scripts/grid.ts` hands the starts to
`scripts/make-audio.py --launch`. Change a scene's beats, then run `npm run launch:audio`. `LaunchVideo` takes `music`
and `sfx` props to render either layer on its own. The creators on Discover take a portrait each (`photo` in
`CREATORS`, `src/launch/app-screens.tsx`, a file in `public/`); without one the tile shows the initials.

slam, a select tick; `SfxGain` (`src/audio.tsx`) sets their overall level. Every scene lasts whole beats (`beats` in
`src/launch/scenes.tsx`), so every cut lands on a beat; `scripts/grid.ts` hands the starts to
`scripts/make-audio.py --launch`. Change a scene's beats, then run `npm run launch:audio`. `LaunchVideo` takes `music`
and `sfx` props to render either layer on its own. The creators on Discover take a portrait each (`photo` in
`CREATORS`, `src/launch/app-screens.tsx`, a file in `public/`); without one the tile shows the initials.

The music is keynote pop, picked from four samples: 108 BPM, D flat major (I-V-vi-IV), a piano pulsing eighths, a
kalimba figure in 3-3-2, a bass in eighths, four on the floor with claps and a shaker, a glockenspiel hook in the
later grooves. The instruments are the FluidR3 GM soundfont (MIT) played through fluidsynth
(`apt install fluidsynth fluid-soundfont-gm`, `pip install mido`); kick, snaps and risers are synthesised. Quiet and
filtered under the opening lines, a break under "Ein Swipe" and under the switch to brands, drums out for the logo,
soft again under the call to action. The effects stay minimal: a quiet, muffled mechanical keyboard, a soft whip and
slam, a select tick; `SfxGain` (`src/audio.tsx`) sets their overall level. Every scene lasts whole beats (`beats` in
`src/launch/scenes.tsx`), so every cut lands on a beat; `scripts/grid.ts` hands the starts to
`scripts/make-audio.py --launch`. Change a scene's beats, then run `npm run launch:audio`. `LaunchVideo` takes `music`
and `sfx` props to render either layer on its own. The creators on Discover take a portrait each (`photo` in
`CREATORS`, `src/launch/app-screens.tsx`, a file in `public/`); without one the tile shows the initials.

with its choice sheets, Discover), `phone.tsx` the iPhone and the Feed as the app draws it on a phone,

```bash
npm run launch:stills   # one still per scene (its keyframe) to out/launch/ and a contact sheet out/launch-stills.png
npm run launch:raw      # the picture only: out/launch-raw.mp4

npm run launch:render   # with sound, mastered to -14 LUFS: out/launch-final.mp4
```

The music is keynote pop, picked from four samples: 108 BPM, D flat major (I-V-vi-IV), a piano pulsing eighths, a
kalimba figure in 3-3-2, a bass in eighths, four on the floor with claps and a shaker, a glockenspiel hook in the
later grooves. The instruments are the FluidR3 GM soundfont (MIT) played through fluidsynth
(`apt install fluidsynth fluid-soundfont-gm`, `pip install mido`); kick, snaps and risers are synthesised. Quiet and
filtered under the opening lines, a break under "Ein Swipe" and under the switch to brands, drums out for the logo,
soft again under the call to action. The effects stay minimal: a quiet, muffled mechanical keyboard, a soft whip and
slam, a select tick; `SfxGain` (`src/audio.tsx`) sets their overall level. Every scene lasts whole beats (`beats` in
`src/launch/scenes.tsx`), so every cut lands on a beat; `scripts/grid.ts` hands the starts to
`scripts/make-audio.py --launch`. Change a scene's beats, then run `npm run launch:audio`. `LaunchVideo` takes `music`
and `sfx` props to render either layer on its own. The creators on Discover take a portrait each (`photo` in
`CREATORS`, `src/launch/app-screens.tsx`, a file in `public/`); without one the tile shows the initials.

The music is keynote pop, picked from four samples: 108 BPM, D flat major (I-V-vi-IV), a piano pulsing eighths, a
kalimba figure in 3-3-2, a bass in eighths, four on the floor with claps and a shaker, a glockenspiel hook in the
later grooves. The instruments are the FluidR3 GM soundfont (MIT) played through fluidsynth
(`apt install fluidsynth fluid-soundfont-gm`, `pip install mido`); kick, snaps and risers are synthesised. Quiet and
filtered under the opening lines, a break under "Ein Swipe" and under the switch to brands, drums out for the logo,
soft again under the call to action. The effects stay minimal: a quiet, muffled mechanical keyboard, a soft whip and
slam, a select tick; `SfxGain` (`src/audio.tsx`) sets their overall level. Every scene lasts whole beats (`beats` in
`src/launch/scenes.tsx`), so every cut lands on a beat; `scripts/grid.ts` hands the starts to
`scripts/make-audio.py --launch`. Change a scene's beats, then run `npm run launch:audio`. `LaunchVideo` takes `music`
and `sfx` props to render either layer on its own. The creators on Discover take a portrait each (`photo` in
`CREATORS`, `src/launch/app-screens.tsx`, a file in `public/`); without one the tile shows the initials.

The music is keynote pop, picked from four samples: 108 BPM, D flat major (I-V-vi-IV), a piano pulsing eighths, a
kalimba figure in 3-3-2, a bass in eighths, four on the floor with claps and a shaker, a glockenspiel hook in the
later grooves. The instruments are the FluidR3 GM soundfont (MIT) played through fluidsynth
(`apt install fluidsynth fluid-soundfont-gm`, `pip install mido`); kick, snaps and risers are synthesised. Quiet and
filtered under the opening lines, a break under "Ein Swipe" and under the switch to brands, drums out for the logo,
soft again under the call to action. The effects stay minimal: a quiet, muffled mechanical keyboard, a soft whip and
slam, a select tick; `SfxGain` (`src/audio.tsx`) sets their overall level. Every scene lasts whole beats (`beats` in
`src/launch/scenes.tsx`), so every cut lands on a beat; `scripts/grid.ts` hands the starts to
`scripts/make-audio.py --launch`. Change a scene's beats, then run `npm run launch:audio`. `LaunchVideo` takes `music`
and `sfx` props to render either layer on its own. The creators on Discover take a portrait each (`photo` in
`CREATORS`, `src/launch/app-screens.tsx`, a file in `public/`); without one the tile shows the initials.

(springs, fly-ins, typing rhythm, pointer arcs, background arcs, app frames), `parts.tsx` shared pieces (typed lines,
slamming words, key sounds), `screens.tsx` and `app-screens.tsx` the app's screens (offer card, chat, request form
with its choice sheets, Discover), `phone.tsx` the iPhone and the Feed as the app draws it on a phone,
`scenes-creator.tsx` and `scenes-brand.tsx` the scenes, `scenes.tsx` their order and lengths.

```bash
npm run launch:stills   # one still per scene (its keyframe) to out/launch/ and a contact sheet out/launch-stills.png
npm run launch:raw      # the picture only: out/launch-raw.mp4
npm run launch:audio    # regenerate its music and sounds (needs python3, numpy, ffmpeg, fluidsynth, mido)
npm run launch:render   # with sound, mastered to -14 LUFS: out/launch-final.mp4
```

The music is keynote pop, picked from four samples: 108 BPM, D flat major (I-V-vi-IV), a piano pulsing eighths, a
kalimba figure in 3-3-2, a bass in eighths, four on the floor with claps and a shaker, a glockenspiel hook in the
later grooves. The instruments are the FluidR3 GM soundfont (MIT) played through fluidsynth
(`apt install fluidsynth fluid-soundfont-gm`, `pip install mido`); kick, snaps and risers are synthesised. Quiet and
filtered under the opening lines, a break under "Ein Swipe" and under the switch to brands, drums out for the logo,
soft again under the call to action. The effects stay minimal: a quiet, muffled mechanical keyboard, a soft whip and
slam, a select tick; `SfxGain` (`src/audio.tsx`) sets their overall level. Every scene lasts whole beats (`beats` in
`src/launch/scenes.tsx`), so every cut lands on a beat; `scripts/grid.ts` hands the starts to
`scripts/make-audio.py --launch`. Change a scene's beats, then run `npm run launch:audio`. `LaunchVideo` takes `music`
and `sfx` props to render either layer on its own. The creators on Discover take a portrait each (`photo` in
`CREATORS`, `src/launch/app-screens.tsx`, a file in `public/`); without one the tile shows the initials.

npm run launch:stills   # one still per scene (its keyframe) to out/launch/ and a contact sheet out/launch-stills.png
npm run launch:raw      # the picture only: out/launch-raw.mp4
npm run launch:audio    # regenerate its music and sounds (needs python3, numpy, ffmpeg, fluidsynth, mido)
npm run launch:render   # with sound, mastered to -14 LUFS: out/launch-final.mp4
```

The music is keynote pop, picked from four samples: 108 BPM, D flat major (I-V-vi-IV), a piano pulsing eighths, a
kalimba figure in 3-3-2, a bass in eighths, four on the floor with claps and a shaker, a glockenspiel hook in the
later grooves. The instruments are the FluidR3 GM soundfont (MIT) played through fluidsynth
(`apt install fluidsynth fluid-soundfont-gm`, `pip install mido`); kick, snaps and risers are synthesised. Quiet and
filtered under the opening lines, a break under "Ein Swipe" and under the switch to brands, drums out for the logo,
soft again under the call to action. The effects stay minimal: a quiet, muffled mechanical keyboard, a soft whip and
slam, a select tick; `SfxGain` (`src/audio.tsx`) sets their overall level. Every scene lasts whole beats (`beats` in
`src/launch/scenes.tsx`), so every cut lands on a beat; `scripts/grid.ts` hands the starts to
`scripts/make-audio.py --launch`. Change a scene's beats, then run `npm run launch:audio`. `LaunchVideo` takes `music`
and `sfx` props to render either layer on its own. The creators on Discover take a portrait each (`photo` in
`CREATORS`, `src/launch/app-screens.tsx`, a file in `public/`); without one the tile shows the initials.
lA launch video for the website, YouTube and LinkedIn, 1920 x 1080, modelled on the cut of a SaaS launch video: typed
lines, statements set large, the web app's desktop view in 3D, the swipe on an iPhone, three lights (white, grey
mist, black), thin lines in the background now and then. Sources in `src/launch/`: `kit.tsx` building blocks
(springs, fly-ins, typing rhythm, pointer arcs, background arcs, app frames), `parts.tsx` shared pieces (typed lines,
slamming words, key sounds), `screens.tsx` and `app-screens.tsx` the app's screens (offer card, chat, request form
with its choice sheets, Discover), `phone.tsx` the iPhone and the Feed as the app draws it on a phone,
`scenes-creator.tsx` and `scenes-brand.tsx` the scenes, `scenes.tsx` their order and lengths.

kalimba figure in 3-3-2, a bass in eighths, four on the floor with claps and a shaker, a glockenspiel hook in the
later grooves. The instruments are the FluidR3 GM soundfont (MIT) played through fluidsynth
(`apt install fluidsynth fluid-soundfont-gm`, `pip install mido`); kick, snaps and risers are synthesised. Quiet and
filtered under the opening lines, a break under "Ein Swipe" and under the switch to brands, drums out for the logo,
soft again under the call to action. The effects stay minimal: a quiet, muffled mechanical keyboard, a soft whip and
slam, a select tick; `SfxGain` (`src/audio.tsx`) sets their overall level. Every scene lasts whole beats (`beats` in
`src/launch/scenes.tsx`), so every cut lands on a beat; `scripts/grid.ts` hands the starts to
`scripts/make-audio.py --launch`. Change a scene's beats, then run `npm run launch:audio`. `LaunchVideo` takes `music`
and `sfx` props to render either layer on its own. The creators on Discover take a portrait each (`photo` in
`CREATORS`, `src/launch/app-screens.tsx`, a file in `public/`); without one the tile shows the initials.
sA launch video for the website, YouTube and LinkedIn, 1920 x 1080, modelled on the cut of a SaaS launch video: typed
lines, statements set large, the web app's desktop view in 3D, the swipe on an iPhone, three lights (white, grey
mist, black), thin lines in the background now and then. Sources in `src/launch/`: `kit.tsx` building blocks
(springs, fly-ins, typing rhythm, pointer arcs, background arcs, app frames), `parts.tsx` shared pieces (typed lines,
slamming words, key sounds), `screens.tsx` and `app-screens.tsx` the app's screens (offer card, chat, request form
with its choice sheets, Discover), `phone.tsx` the iPhone and the Feed as the app draws it on a phone,
`scenes-creator.tsx` and `scenes-brand.tsx` the scenes, `scenes.tsx` their order and lengths.

```bash
npm run launch:stills   # one still per scene (its keyframe) to out/launch/ and a contact sheet out/launch-stills.png
npm run launch:raw      # the picture only: out/launch-raw.mp4
npm run launch:audio    # regenerate its music and sounds (needs python3, numpy, ffmpeg, fluidsynth, mido)
npm run launch:render   # with sound, mastered to -14 LUFS: out/launch-final.mp4
```

lines, statements set large, the web app's desktop view in 3D, the swipe on an iPhone, three lights (white, grey

The music is keynote pop, picked from four samples: 108 BPM, D flat major (I-V-vi-IV), a piano pulsing eighths, a
kalimba figure in 3-3-2, a bass in eighths, four on the floor with claps and a shaker, a glockenspiel hook in the
later grooves. The instruments are the FluidR3 GM soundfont (MIT) played through fluidsynth
(`apt install fluidsynth fluid-soundfont-gm`, `pip install mido`); kick, snaps and risers are synthesised. Quiet and
filtered under the opening lines, a break under "Ein Swipe" and under the switch to brands, drums out for the logo,
soft again under the call to action. The effects stay minimal: a quiet, muffled mechanical keyboard, a soft whip and
slam, a select tick; `SfxGain` (`src/audio.tsx`) sets their overall level. Every scene lasts whole beats (`beats` in
`src/launch/scenes.tsx`), so every cut lands on a beat; `scripts/grid.ts` hands the starts to
`scripts/make-audio.py --launch`. Change a scene's beats, then run `npm run launch:audio`. `LaunchVideo` takes `music`
and `sfx` props to render either layer on its own. The creators on Discover take a portrait each (`photo` in
`CREATORS`, `src/launch/app-screens.tsx`, a file in `public/`); without one the tile shows the initials.

```bash
npm run launch:stills   # one still per scene (its keyframe) to out/launch/ and a contact sheet out/launch-stills.png
npm run launch:raw      # the picture only: out/launch-raw.mp4
npm run launch:audio    # regenerate its music and sounds (needs python3, numpy, ffmpeg, fluidsynth, mido)
npm run launch:render   # with sound, mastered to -14 LUFS: out/launch-final.mp4
```

The music is keynote pop, picked from four samples: 108 BPM, D flat major (I-V-vi-IV), a piano pulsing eighths, a
kalimba figure in 3-3-2, a bass in eighths, four on the floor with claps and a shaker, a glockenspiel hook in the
later grooves. The instruments are the FluidR3 GM soundfont (MIT) played through fluidsynth
(`apt install fluidsynth fluid-soundfont-gm`, `pip install mido`); kick, snaps and risers are synthesised. Quiet and
filtered under the opening lines, a break under "Ein Swipe" and under the switch to brands, drums out for the logo,
soft again under the call to action. The effects stay minimal: a quiet, muffled mechanical keyboard, a soft whip and
slam, a select tick; `SfxGain` (`src/audio.tsx`) sets their overall level. Every scene lasts whole beats (`beats` in
`src/launch/scenes.tsx`), so every cut lands on a beat; `scripts/grid.ts` hands the starts to
`scripts/make-audio.py --launch`. Change a scene's beats, then run `npm run launch:audio`. `LaunchVideo` takes `music`
and `sfx` props to render either layer on its own. The creators on Discover take a portrait each (`photo` in
`CREATORS`, `src/launch/app-screens.tsx`, a file in `public/`); without one the tile shows the initials.

The music is keynote pop, picked from four samples: 108 BPM, D flat major (I-V-vi-IV), a piano pulsing eighths, a
kalimba figure in 3-3-2, a bass in eighths, four on the floor with claps and a shaker, a glockenspiel hook in the
later grooves. The instruments are the FluidR3 GM soundfont (MIT) played through fluidsynth
(`apt install fluidsynth fluid-soundfont-gm`, `pip install mido`); kick, snaps and risers are synthesised. Quiet and
filtered under the opening lines, a break under "Ein Swipe" and under the switch to brands, drums out for the logo,
soft again under the call to action. The effects stay minimal: a quiet, muffled mechanical keyboard, a soft whip and
slam, a select tick; `SfxGain` (`src/audio.tsx`) sets their overall level. Every scene lasts whole beats (`beats` in
`src/launch/scenes.tsx`), so every cut lands on a beat; `scripts/grid.ts` hands the starts to
`scripts/make-audio.py --launch`. Change a scene's beats, then run `npm run launch:audio`. `LaunchVideo` takes `music`
and `sfx` props to render either layer on its own. The creators on Discover take a portrait each (`photo` in
`CREATORS`, `src/launch/app-screens.tsx`, a file in `public/`); without one the tile shows the initials.

slam, a select tick; `SfxGain` (`src/audio.tsx`) sets their overall level. Every scene lasts whole beats (`beats` in
`src/launch/scenes.tsx`), so every cut lands on a beat; `scripts/grid.ts` hands the starts to
`scripts/make-audio.py --launch`. Change a scene's beats, then run `npm run launch:audio`. `LaunchVideo` takes `music`
and `sfx` props to render either layer on its own. The creators on Discover take a portrait each (`photo` in
`CREATORS`, `src/launch/app-screens.tsx`, a file in `public/`); without one the tile shows the initials.

nA launch video for the website, YouTube and LinkedIn, 1920 x 1080, modelled on the cut of a SaaS launch video: typed
lines, statements set large, the web app's desktop view in 3D, the swipe on an iPhone, three lights (white, grey
mist, black), thin lines in the background now and then. Sources in `src/launch/`: `kit.tsx` building blocks
(springs, fly-ins, typing rhythm, pointer arcs, background arcs, app frames), `parts.tsx` shared pieces (typed lines,

```

The music is keynote pop, picked from four samples: 108 BPM, D flat major (I-V-vi-IV), a piano pulsing eighths, a
kalimba figure in 3-3-2, a bass in eighths, four on the floor with claps and a shaker, a glockenspiel hook in the
later grooves. The instruments are the FluidR3 GM soundfont (MIT) played through fluidsynth
(`apt install fluidsynth fluid-soundfont-gm`, `pip install mido`); kick, snaps and risers are synthesised. Quiet and
filtered under the opening lines, a break under "Ein Swipe" and under the switch to brands, drums out for the logo,
soft again under the call to action. The effects stay minimal: a quiet, muffled mechanical keyboard, a soft whip and
slam, a select tick; `SfxGain` (`src/audio.tsx`) sets their overall level. Every scene lasts whole beats (`beats` in
`src/launch/scenes.tsx`), so every cut lands on a beat; `scripts/grid.ts` hands the starts to
`scripts/make-audio.py --launch`. Change a scene's beats, then run `npm run launch:audio`. `LaunchVideo` takes `music`
and `sfx` props to render either layer on its own. The creators on Discover take a portrait each (`photo` in
`CREATORS`, `src/launch/app-screens.tsx`, a file in `public/`); without one the tile shows the initials.

with its choice sheets, Discover), `phone.tsx` the iPhone and the Feed as the app draws it on a phone,

```

The music is keynote pop, picked from four samples: 108 BPM, D flat major (I-V-vi-IV), a piano pulsing eighths, a
kalimba figure in 3-3-2, a bass in eighths, four on the floor with claps and a shaker, a glockenspiel hook in the
later grooves. The instruments are the FluidR3 GM soundfont (MIT) played through fluidsynth
(`apt install fluidsynth fluid-soundfont-gm`, `pip install mido`); kick, snaps and risers are synthesised. Quiet and
filtered under the opening lines, a break under "Ein Swipe" and under the switch to brands, drums out for the logo,
soft again under the call to action. The effects stay minimal: a quiet, muffled mechanical keyboard, a soft whip and
slam, a select tick; `SfxGain` (`src/audio.tsx`) sets their overall level. Every scene lasts whole beats (`beats` in
`src/launch/scenes.tsx`), so every cut lands on a beat; `scripts/grid.ts` hands the starts to
`scripts/make-audio.py --launch`. Change a scene's beats, then run `npm run launch:audio`. `LaunchVideo` takes `music`
and `sfx` props to render either layer on its own. The creators on Discover take a portrait each (`photo` in
`CREATORS`, `src/launch/app-screens.tsx`, a file in `public/`); without one the tile shows the initials.

The music is keynote pop, picked from four samples: 108 BPM, D flat major (I-V-vi-IV), a piano pulsing eighths, a
kalimba figure in 3-3-2, a bass in eighths, four on the floor with claps and a shaker, a glockenspiel hook in the
later grooves. The instruments are the FluidR3 GM soundfont (MIT) played through fluidsynth
(`apt install fluidsynth fluid-soundfont-gm`, `pip install mido`); kick, snaps and risers are synthesised. Quiet and
filtered under the opening lines, a break under "Ein Swipe" and under the switch to brands, drums out for the logo,
soft again under the call to action. The effects stay minimal: a quiet, muffled mechanical keyboard, a soft whip and
slam, a select tick; `SfxGain` (`src/audio.tsx`) sets their overall level. Every scene lasts whole beats (`beats` in
`src/launch/scenes.tsx`), so every cut lands on a beat; `scripts/grid.ts` hands the starts to
`scripts/make-audio.py --launch`. Change a scene's beats, then run `npm run launch:audio`. `LaunchVideo` takes `music`
and `sfx` props to render either layer on its own. The creators on Discover take a portrait each (`photo` in
`CREATORS`, `src/launch/app-screens.tsx`, a file in `public/`); without one the tile shows the initials.

mA launch video for the website, YouTube and LinkedIn, 1920 x 1080, modelled on the cut of a SaaS launch video: typed

The music is keynote pop, picked from four samples: 108 BPM, D flat major (I-V-vi-IV), a piano pulsing eighths, a
kalimba figure in 3-3-2, a bass in eighths, four on the floor with claps and a shaker, a glockenspiel hook in the
later grooves. The instruments are the FluidR3 GM soundfont (MIT) played through fluidsynth
(`apt install fluidsynth fluid-soundfont-gm`, `pip install mido`); kick, snaps and risers are synthesised. Quiet and
filtered under the opening lines, a break under "Ein Swipe" and under the switch to brands, drums out for the logo,
soft again under the call to action. The effects stay minimal: a quiet, muffled mechanical keyboard, a soft whip and
slam, a select tick; `SfxGain` (`src/audio.tsx`) sets their overall level. Every scene lasts whole beats (`beats` in
`src/launch/scenes.tsx`), so every cut lands on a beat; `scripts/grid.ts` hands the starts to
`scripts/make-audio.py --launch`. Change a scene's beats, then run `npm run launch:audio`. `LaunchVideo` takes `music`
and `sfx` props to render either layer on its own. The creators on Discover take a portrait each (`photo` in
`CREATORS`, `src/launch/app-screens.tsx`, a file in `public/`); without one the tile shows the initials.

(springs, fly-ins, typing rhythm, pointer arcs, background arcs, app frames), `parts.tsx` shared pieces (typed lines,
slamming words, key sounds), `screens.tsx` and `app-screens.tsx` the app's screens (offer card, chat, request form
with its choice sheets, Discover), `phone.tsx` the iPhone and the Feed as the app draws it on a phone,
`scenes-creator.tsx` and `scenes-brand.tsx` the scenes, `scenes.tsx` their order and lengths.

```bash
npm run launch:stills   # one still per scene (its keyframe) to out/launch/ and a contact sheet out/launch-stills.png
npm run launch:raw      # the picture only: out/launch-raw.mp4
npm run launch:audio    # regenerate its music and sounds (needs python3, numpy, ffmpeg, fluidsynth, mido)
npm run launch:render   # with sound, mastered to -14 LUFS: out/launch-final.mp4
```

The music is keynote pop, picked from four samples: 108 BPM, D flat major (I-V-vi-IV), a piano pulsing eighths, a
kalimba figure in 3-3-2, a bass in eighths, four on the floor with claps and a shaker, a glockenspiel hook in the
later grooves. The instruments are the FluidR3 GM soundfont (MIT) played through fluidsynth
(`apt install fluidsynth fluid-soundfont-gm`, `pip install mido`); kick, snaps and risers are synthesised. Quiet and
filtered under the opening lines, a break under "Ein Swipe" and under the switch to brands, drums out for the logo,
soft again under the call to action. The effects stay minimal: a quiet, muffled mechanical keyboard, a soft whip and
slam, a select tick; `SfxGain` (`src/audio.tsx`) sets their overall level. Every scene lasts whole beats (`beats` in
`src/launch/scenes.tsx`), so every cut lands on a beat; `scripts/grid.ts` hands the starts to
`scripts/make-audio.py --launch`. Change a scene's beats, then run `npm run launch:audio`. `LaunchVideo` takes `music`
and `sfx` props to render either layer on its own. The creators on Discover take a portrait each (`photo` in
`CREATORS`, `src/launch/app-screens.tsx`, a file in `public/`); without one the tile shows the initials.

npm run launch:stills   # one still per scene (its keyframe) to out/launch/ and a contact sheet out/launch-stills.png
npm run launch:raw      # the picture only: out/launch-raw.mp4
npm run launch:audio    # regenerate its music and sounds (needs python3, numpy, ffmpeg, fluidsynth, mido)
npm run launch:render   # with sound, mastered to -14 LUFS: out/launch-final.mp4
```

The music is keynote pop, picked from four samples: 108 BPM, D flat major (I-V-vi-IV), a piano pulsing eighths, a
kalimba figure in 3-3-2, a bass in eighths, four on the floor with claps and a shaker, a glockenspiel hook in the
later grooves. The instruments are the FluidR3 GM soundfont (MIT) played through fluidsynth
(`apt install fluidsynth fluid-soundfont-gm`, `pip install mido`); kick, snaps and risers are synthesised. Quiet and
filtered under the opening lines, a break under "Ein Swipe" and under the switch to brands, drums out for the logo,
soft again under the call to action. The effects stay minimal: a quiet, muffled mechanical keyboard, a soft whip and
slam, a select tick; `SfxGain` (`src/audio.tsx`) sets their overall level. Every scene lasts whole beats (`beats` in
`src/launch/scenes.tsx`), so every cut lands on a beat; `scripts/grid.ts` hands the starts to
`scripts/make-audio.py --launch`. Change a scene's beats, then run `npm run launch:audio`. `LaunchVideo` takes `music`
and `sfx` props to render either layer on its own. The creators on Discover take a portrait each (`photo` in
`CREATORS`, `src/launch/app-screens.tsx`, a file in `public/`); without one the tile shows the initials.
hA launch video for the website, YouTube and LinkedIn, 1920 x 1080, modelled on the cut of a SaaS launch video: typed
lines, statements set large, the web app's desktop view in 3D, the swipe on an iPhone, three lights (white, grey
mist, black), thin lines in the background now and then. Sources in `src/launch/`: `kit.tsx` building blocks
(springs, fly-ins, typing rhythm, pointer arcs, background arcs, app frames), `parts.tsx` shared pieces (typed lines,
slamming words, key sounds), `screens.tsx` and `app-screens.tsx` the app's screens (offer card, chat, request form
with its choice sheets, Discover), `phone.tsx` the iPhone and the Feed as the app draws it on a phone,
`scenes-creator.tsx` and `scenes-brand.tsx` the scenes, `scenes.tsx` their order and lengths.
